name: cad-skill
description: Claude Code skill for parametric 3D-printable model generation with CadQuery
readme_summary: This repository provides a Claude Code skill that leverages CadQuery to generate parametric 3D-printable models. Users can describe a desired object, and the skill will automatically write the CadQuery script, export an STL file, and provide previews, allowing for iterative refinement.
key_features: Integration with Claude Code for natural language interaction
Automatic script generation based on user descriptions
Iterative design process with AI assistance
Scan-to-pocket pipeline for custom object fitting
primary_use_case: To enable users to easily design and generate custom 3D-printable parts through natural language interaction with an AI assistant, powered by CadQuery for parametric modeling.
cover_image_prompt: A friendly AI assistant, depicted as a helpful robot crafting intricate 3D models, stands in a workshop. In front of the robot, a user describes a desired object using a speech bubble containing simple icons representing a bracket or a container. The AI's hands are shown manipulating glowing digital blueprints that transform into physical, 3D-printed objects (like a phone stand or a custom bin) emerging from a 3D printer bed. Subtle lines of code and geometric shapes float around the AI, indicating the underlying CadQuery process. The overall scene is bright, clean, and uses a modern, slightly stylized 3D isometric illustration style, emphasizing creativity and ease of use.

name: Podroid
description: A rootless Android app that boots Alpine Linux: run containers (Podman/Docker/LXC) and GUI desktop apps.
readme_summary: Podroid is a rootless Android application that allows users to run a full Alpine Linux virtual machine directly on their device. It supports containerization tools like Podman, Docker, and LXC, as well as GUI Linux applications, all without requiring root access.
key_features: Run Podman, Docker, and LXC containers
Full Alpine Linux VM with custom kernel or AVF
X11 desktop environment for GUI apps
USB passthrough, SSH, and port forwarding
Container backup and live VM status
primary_use_case: Running Linux environments, including containers and desktop applications, on an Android device without root privileges.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, stylized illustration of an Android phone transforming into a miniature, bustling Linux server room. Inside the phone's screen, tiny, intricate servers are humming, with colorful data streams flowing out and connecting to a small, glowing desktop monitor displaying a Linux GUI. A stylized 'P' logo (for Podroid) is subtly integrated into the phone's design. The background is a clean, abstract digital space with subtle circuit patterns. The overall mood is one of powerful, contained technology. The art style should be a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with bright, contrasting colors and clear visual metaphors for containers and desktop environments.

name: MoneyPrinterTurbo
description: 利用 AI 大模型和自动化工作流，根据主题或关键词一键生成高清短视频。Generate HD short videos from a topic or keyword with an automated AI workflow.
readme_summary: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an automated AI tool that generates high-definition short videos from a given topic or keyword. It handles the entire workflow, from scriptwriting and material matching to subtitle generation and final video synthesis.
primary_use_case: To automatically generate short-form videos (e.g., for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) based on user-provided topics or keywords, streamlining content creation.
cover_image_prompt: A magical, steampunk-inspired printing press that is actively churning out vibrant, short video clips onto a conveyor belt. The input to the press is a single glowing keyword or topic floating in the air. As the videos emerge, they are automatically adorned with subtitles and background music notes. The overall scene is dynamic and creative, with subtle digital particles and UI elements hinting at AI and automation. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with a warm, inviting color palette, emphasizing the ease and magic of content creation.

name: scroll-world
description: A skill that turn any brand into a scrollable 3D world landing page
readme_summary: This repository provides a skill for AI agents like Claude Code and Codex to generate immersive, scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing pages for brands. It uses AI to create scenes and camera flights, allowing users to experience a continuous, fly-through narrative as they scroll.
key_features: Generates immersive, scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing pages
AI-driven scene and camera flight generation
Seamless camera transitions between scenes (no cuts)
Interactive interview process for brand, art direction, and scene order
Budget estimation and approval before generation
primary_use_case: Creating unique, interactive, and visually engaging brand landing pages that simulate a 'fly-through' experience.
cover_image_prompt: A whimsical, stylized hot air balloon, branded with 'scroll-world', gently floating through a miniature, fantastical 3D world composed of interconnected dioramas. As the balloon drifts, the landscape below seamlessly transforms, revealing new scenes like a book opening its pages. Small, glowing data streams flow from the balloon towards the world, symbolizing AI generation. In the background, subtle UI elements resembling a timeline or scrollbar are visible. The overall mood is adventurous and magical, rendered in a vibrant, 3D isometric illustration style with soft, inviting lighting.
